messages:
Alex Kim: quick check — who's owning NL2 region residency for the new customers? need KMS access + routing policy before we open it to staging.
Priya Nair: I can take KMS and IAM reviews. blocked on security signoff for cross-project key grant (ticket SEC-312). ETA wed. :clock3:
Jamal Chen: routing/egress team here. we need to confirm router pairs and the fallback policy. currently planned: primary nl2-west, fallback nl1-east. want TLDR on data-residency constraints — are we allowing async replica across zones?
Alex Kim: customers require data-at-rest to stay in NL region but async replicas to NL2 only. no cross-country copies. we can use cross-zone but not cross-country.
Lina Torres: added the residency matrix to the infra doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/regions/nl2 (see section 2.1). also noted KMS key policy pattern: `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/regional-nl/cryptoKeys/nl2-key`
Priya Nair: for IAM the pattern is `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` with a binding to `redwood-service-nl2@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. raising a PR for terraform. snippet: ```resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "nl2_grants" { resource = google_kms_crypto_key.nl2_key.name role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter" members = ["serviceAccount:redwood-service-nl2@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com"] }```
Jamal Chen: thanks. on routing side will add a canary route that pins 5% traffic to nl2 via edge-router rules. canary window request: 48h with manual rollback. planning task: update route table `rt-edge-nl` and `rt-fallback`.
Alex Kim: who owns the route change PR? pinging codeowners for review. @Jamal if you open the PR can you tag infra-sre + deploy?
Jamal Chen: will open PR in 30m. tagging @Lina for netpol review. deploy-bot: CI will run on new route PR.
deploy-bot: PR #4823 — route-table updates — CI started (build 789).
Priya Nair: FYI SEC asked for audit logging enabled on the KMS key. adding `audit_configs` block to TF. small change, shouldn't affect rollout.
oncall-bot: reminder — scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC for NL region network patch. expect short BGP reconvergence.
Alex Kim: ok combined checklist then: (1) Priya: KMS PR + security signoff (SEC-312) (2) Jamal: route PR + canary config (3) Lina: netpol & docs update (4) me: coordinate staging cutover after canary green. target milestone: nl2-staging-open by Fri EOD.
Lina Torres: noted, I'll update the infra doc and add the netpol snippet.
Jamal Chen: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4823 — canary rule + rollback. tagging infra-sre. :eyes:
Alex Kim: awesome. if anyone hits blockers drop them here and I'll escalate to platform leads. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: will post PR link when ready.
